description: This file defines a controller class 'jjwg_AreasController' for handling map-related actions within the SuiteCRM module 'jjwg_Areas'. It includes methods for rendering different map views ('area_edit_map' and 'area_detail_map') based on provided identifiers.

classes.name: jjwg_AreasController
classes.description: Controller class handling map display actions for map areas in the SuiteCRM 'jjwg_Areas' module.

methods.name: action_area_edit_map
methods.description: Prepares data and sets the view for editing area map.

methods.name: action_area_detail_map
methods.description: Prepares data and sets the view for displaying detailed area map.
